utility.notes: Oceanside is a well-documented San Diego County city within SDG&E's core service territory, consistent with SDG&E-territory records established elsewhere this session.

value.name: Clean Energy Alliance (CEA)
value.notes: CEA's own homepage confirms Oceanside as one of its 7 member cities (Carlsbad, Del Mar, Escondido, Oceanside, San Marcos, Solana Beach, Vista); Oceanside began CEA service in 2024. Per CEA's own description: 'Clean Energy Alliance purchases power directly from power providers and/or builds energy generation sources' while 'SDG&E delivers energy, handles billing and serves customers.'

interconnection_url.notes: SDG&E's own utility-wide Net Energy Metering (NEM) interconnection page, already established for other SDG&E-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Center for Sustainable Energy (CSE), on behalf of SDG&E, under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered across SDG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Oceanside.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)
